Untagged list subcommand output containing the four fixed catalog choices (manual append/revision, observation response and declared provenance) and their schema-document URNs. URNs identify completed-structure documents, not artifact instance schema IDs. The show subcommand emits the selected schema document itself. No private input is checked by list/show; no downstream report consumer is established.

Untagged completed-structure check result for explicitly selected manual append/revision cards, observation response or declared provenance inputs. Reports static errors only; no manifest/source reads, import validation, hash binding, semantic check or approval. Python consumers of the cards are authoritative but do not consume this report. Existing editor profiles accept placeholders and describe a different acceptance set.
